description: Milestone 3: calibration and labeled recording. Guided self-calibration (empty room baseline, walking, standing still, ordinary sitting) that derives noise levels and preliminary thresholds and persists them per sensor configuration; a labeled recording interface organized by session; replay of recorded sessions through the same pipeline. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: Create backend/calibration.py: CalibrationSession state machine with steps EMPTY_BASELINE (configurable 15-30 s, default 20 s), WALKING (default 15 s), STANDING_STILL (default 10 s), SITTING (default 10 s), then COMPUTE. During each step collect the engine's processed frames and normalized amplitude profiles (driven from Engine, not from the UI thread). Compute: baseline per-subcarrier mean and std profile (empty room), noise level of each feature (median and p95 of motion features in empty room), per-step feature distributions (median, p95), and preliminary thresholds: low threshold between empty/still p95 and walking median, movement threshold, rapid threshold from walking p95 scaled; enforce monotonic ordering and fall back with a warning if steps are not separable (e.g. walking not above baseline). Refuse to compute if data quality was insufficient during a step and report why.

Persist calibration to data/calibration/<sensor_key>.json where sensor_key is derived from TX MAC, channel, secondary channel, chip family, CSI len and a user-editable placement name (e.g. 'living-room'); include created timestamp, source kind and synthetic flag (calibrations computed from simulation are marked synthetic and must not be auto-loaded for live sources). Engine auto-loads the matching calibration when the sensor configuration is detected and the SignalProcessor uses its baseline and noise normalization; support listing, loading, deleting (with confirmation) and recalibrating.

Create backend/recording.py (or extend backend/recorder.py): session layout data/recordings/<session_id>/session.json (session_id = YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-<placement>, created, sensor config, source kind, synthetic flag, notes, app version) and one CSV per labeled take: <take_index>_<label>_<start_ts>.csv with columns host_ts_iso, host_ts_unix, session_id, take_id, label, raw_line, plus parsed metadata columns (rssi, id, channel, len, local_timestamp). Labels exactly: empty_room 'Empty room', standing_still 'Standing still', walking 'Walking', sitting 'Sitting', lying_down 'Lying down', rapid_sitting 'Rapid sitting', simulated_fall 'Simulated fall'. Update session.json with a takes index (label, start, end, packet count, duration). Recording writes happen in the engine thread from raw lines so nothing is dropped by the UI refresh.

Extend ReplaySource and the dashboard replay picker to replay a whole session or a single take through the same parser/processor/detector at 1x/2x/5x speed, and show the take label as ground truth during replay.

Dashboard (Flask server in dashboard/server.py + offline vanilla-JS UI in dashboard/static/, built in FEAT-002): add JSON API routes for calibration (POST /api/calibration/start {placement, durations}, POST /api/calibration/step/start|redo|cancel, GET /api/calibration/state, POST /api/calibration/save, GET /api/calibrations, POST /api/calibration/load, POST /api/calibration/delete) and recording (POST /api/session/create {placement, notes}, GET /api/sessions, POST /api/take/start {label, duration?}, POST /api/take/stop, POST /api/take/delete) with input validation (labels from the fixed list only, safe filenames, no path traversal). Then add a 'Calibration' tab with the guided 4-step wizard (instructions per step, start button, countdown/progress, live quality indicator, ability to redo a step, cancel), then a results view comparing baseline vs walking vs still vs sitting (box/violin or histogram of motion score per step, baseline amplitude profile with std band vs walking profile) and the derived thresholds, with Save and Recalibrate buttons and the active calibration name shown in the status area. Add a 'Record' tab: session create/select with placement name and notes, seven label buttons (start/stop take, optional fixed duration and pre-countdown), live take timer and packet count, list of takes in the session with delete option. Disable recording with live hardware when the serial source is disconnected.

Add tests: tests/test_calibration.py (with frames from in-test numpy generated streams: empty low-variance + walking high-variance produces ordered thresholds; inseparable data triggers warning; insufficient quality refuses; save/load round trip and sensor_key matching; synthetic calibration not auto-applied to live), tests/test_recording.py (session layout, take CSV columns, labels list exact, session.json takes index, replay of a recorded take reproduces the same parsed packets), and extend tests/test_dashboard.py for the new API routes using the Flask test client with data dirs redirected to tmp_path.
Update README.md with the calibration workflow, recording workflow, file layout, and guidance that ML evaluation must hold out complete sessions.
acceptance_criteria: make test passes including calibration and recording tests
Calibration JSON is written under data/calibration/ keyed by sensor configuration and reloaded automatically for the matching configuration
Recording a take produces a session directory with session.json and a labeled CSV containing timestamps, raw CSI lines, metadata and the label
Recorded sessions can be replayed through the same pipeline and the dashboard shows the take label during replay
Calibration and recording API routes are covered by Flask test-client tests (happy path plus invalid label / path traversal rejected with 400)
node --check dashboard/static/app.js passes and no external URLs appear in dashboard/static
verification: .venv/bin/python -m dashboard --no-browser --port 8599 --replay tests/fixtures/classic_esp32s3_sample.txt (background); exercise POST /api/session/create, /api/take/start, /api/take/stop with curl and confirm a session dir with session.json and a take CSV appears under data/recordings/; delete that test session afterwards; stop server
findings:
VERIFIED: make test = 162 passed (99 previous + 63 new: tests/test_calibration.py 13, tests/test_recording.py 21, test_dashboard.py +29 incl. parametrized 400 cases); compileall backend dashboard OK; node --check app.js OK; no http(s):// in dashboard/static; a temporary node smoke harness ran app.js with stubbed DOM/canvas against real API payloads (calibration recording/computed states, active take, take replay with ground truth) without runtime errors. Server verified via a temporary Python wrapper (subprocess `.venv/bin/python -m dashboard --no-browser --port 8599 --replay tests/fixtures/classic_esp32s3_sample.txt --loop`, urllib): session/create, take/start, take/stop (88 packets, session dir with session.json + 001_walking_<ts>.csv, header exact), invalid label and traversal -> 400, calibration start/step start/state/step cancel/save-refused/load-traversal-400/cancel, replay of the session dir showed ground_truth Walking; then SIGTERM; test session dir, generated data/config.json and all temp scripts deleted. NOT verified: browser rendering, real-room calibration, live serial (no ESP32).

API for FEAT-004:
- backend/recording.py: LABELS (ordered dict key->exact name), TAKE_FIELDS, validate_placement(name)->slug (raises RecordingError, a ValueError), validate_label/validate_session_id/validate_take_id, iso(ts), write_json_atomic(path, dict). TakeWriter(path, session_id, take_id, label).write(ts, line, parsed=None). Session(dir, meta).load(dir)/save()/summary()/take_files(). SessionStore(root=data/recordings).create(placement, notes, sensor, source_kind, synthetic)/load(id)/list()/path_for(id). RecordingManager(engine, store): create_session, select_session, list_sessions, can_record()->(ok, reason) (refuses: no session, no running source, finished source, live serial disconnected, synthetic/real mismatch with session.synthetic), start_take(label, duration_s=None), stop_take(reason='user'), delete_take(take_id), status() (session, takes, active_take, last_take, can_record, reason, labels), close(). Takes stop automatically with stop_reason 'duration' | 'source_ended' | 'source_changed' | 'shutdown'. The engine recorder is a sink with accepts_parsed=True; Engine._handle_line now calls rec.write(ts, line, parsed) for such recorders (RawRecorder unchanged). session.json keys: format, session_id, created, created_unix, placement, notes, sensor, source_kind, synthetic, app_version, labels, takes[{take_id 'tNNN', index, label, label_name, file, start, start_unix, end, end_unix, duration_s, packets, lines, requested_duration_s, source_kind, synthetic, sensor, stop_reason}], next_take_index (indices never reused). FEAT-004 train_rf can use Session.load(dir).take_files() / meta['takes'] and the 'label' column; group by session_id.
- backend/sources.py ReplaySource: accepts a session directory (format 'session', takes in order with SESSION_TAKE_GAP_S=0.5 between them), take CSVs and RawRecorder CSVs (detection = header has host_ts_unix and raw_line), raw logs. For labeled files status.extra has session_id/take_id/label/label_name (ground truth, updated per row). ReplaySource.synthetic is read from session.json (dir or parent dir). sources.py now imports backend.recording (no cycle).
- backend/calibration.py: STEPS (StepSpec key/title/instructions/default_s/min_s/max_s: empty_baseline 20 [15-30], walking 15, standing_still 10, sitting 10 [5-60]), CalibrationSession(placement, durations, frame_rate_hz, clock, defaults, settle_s=1.0) with states ready|recording|computed|failed|saved|cancelled, start_step/add_frame(frame, profile, layout, sensor, synthetic, source_kind)/check_timeout/cancel_step/redo(key)/cancel/compute/to_dict. First settle_s (= processing window_s) of each step skipped. Step fails (stays on that step for redo) if ok_fraction<0.8, ok frames < max(20, 0.5*duration*frame_rate), coverage<90%, layout/sensor/synthetic change, timeout (2*duration+15 s wall) or source ended. compute_calibration(steps, placement) raises CalibrationError listing reasons. Result: baseline{mean_profile,std_profile,chip_family,n_subcarriers}, noise_variance/noise_diff (empty medians, floored 1e-6), noise{variance,diff_energy,baseline_deviation,motion_score stats}, steps{key:{stats{motion_score (recomputed calibrated), variance, diff_energy, baseline_deviation (vs new baseline), motion_score_uncalibrated}, profile_mean, profile_std, ...}}, thresholds{low,movement,rapid,calibrated}, separable, quiet_p95, walking_median/p95, warnings, sensor, synthetic, source_kind. Thresholds: quiet=max(p95 empty, p95 standing); separable if walking median >= 1.5*quiet: low=quiet+0.25*gap, movement=quiet+0.5*gap, rapid=max(1.5*walk p95, 2*movement); else fallback low=max(default.low,1.2*quiet), movement=max(default.movement,1.5*low), rapid=max(default.rapid,2*movement) + warning; monotonic gaps enforced (x1.1, x1.2). FEAT-004 FallConfig can derive spike threshold from thresholds.rapid and stillness from thresholds.low. sensor_part(sensor, synthetic)/sensor_key(sensor, placement, synthetic) -> '<placement>__<chip>_<mac hex>_ch<ch>-<sec>_len<len>[__synthetic]'. CalibrationStore(root=data/calibration).save/load/delete/list/find_match(sensor, synthetic, placement). CalibrationManager(engine, store, auto_load=True) registers an engine frame hook: feeds the session and on each (engine.started_at, sensor_part) change auto-loads the newest matching calibration (synthetic only for synthetic sources) or clears a non-matching active one; manual load refuses synthetic calibrations for real sources. Methods start/step_start/step_cancel/step_redo/cancel/save/load/delete/clear/state; last_auto {action loaded|cleared|none}.
- backend/engine.py additions: properties source_kind, synthetic, started_at, source_status, calibration_info, base_thresholds; sensor_config() -> {tx_mac, channel, secondary_channel, chip_family, csi_len, n_subcarriers} | None; apply_calibration(mean, std, noise_variance, noise_diff, thresholds dict, info) sets processor baseline + config.thresholds (calibrated=True) under the engine lock; clear_calibration() restores the config.json thresholds. snapshot(): calibration{active, loaded, name, baseline_source, key, created, synthetic, auto_loaded}, new top-level ground_truth {session_id, take_id, label, label_name} | None.
- dashboard/server.py: create_app(engine, root=None, replay_dirs=None, data_dir=None) (data_dir default root/data; tests pass tmp data_dir); app.config['CALIBRATION'] / ['RECORDING'] hold the managers; helpers _json_body(), _require_confirm(body); CalibrationError/RecordingError -> 400. Routes: GET /api/calibration/state, POST /api/calibration/start|step/start|step/redo|step/cancel|cancel|save|load|delete(confirm:true)|clear, GET /api/calibrations, GET /api/recording, GET /api/sessions, POST /api/session/create|select, POST /api/take/start {label, duration|null}|stop|delete(confirm:true). resolve_replay_path accepts session dirs (must contain session.json) inside allowed dirs; list_replay_files(root, recordings_dir) returns entries with kind session|take|file and groups sessions|takes|recordings|fixtures. __main__ --replay accepts a session directory; RecordingManager.close() on shutdown.
- dashboard/static: tabs array TABS = ['serial','replay','calibration','record'] (extend for 'simulation'); topbar pills calib-pill and rec-pill; motion card 'Ground truth' row; banner appends ground truth label. Shared countdown helper startCountdown(kind, seconds, msgId, label, fn)/cancelCountdown(); setMsg(id, text, cls); renderCalibration/renderRecording polled each tick via /api/calibration/state and /api/recording; canvas drawBoxPlot (log scale) and drawProfiles. New CSS classes: panel-block, split, wizard, steps (st-<status>), step-card, progress-row, msg(.countdown/.error), results, warnings, label-buttons/label-btn(.active), table.takes, sr-only, btn-small.

Deviations / notes: calibration routes also include /api/calibration/cancel (whole wizard) and /api/calibration/clear, plus /api/session/select and /api/recording (not in the plan list). Step lead-in and take pre-countdown are UI-side timers. Calibration step timing uses packet time, so replays at 2x/5x compress time (README advises 1x or as-fast, which keeps original timestamps). Placement names: 1-40 chars [A-Za-z0-9 _-], slugified lowercase. Synthetic calibration keys get a '__synthetic' suffix in addition to synthetic:true. backend __version__ unchanged (0.1.0). tests/csi_synth.py gained GatedReplay(path, gate, **kw) for deterministic engine tests. Firmware untouched; nothing committed; git add -N . done.
